summary: Have fun and learn with Fisher-Price™ games for kids!
description: 🌟Learn and have fun with these educational games for children from Fisher-Price™🌟 Enjoy 10 games that will give you hours of family fun inspired by Fisher-Price™ toys, ideal for kids from 2 to 5 years old. Entertain your children while they play, learn and develop their abilities with a variety of educational and creative activities. HOW TO PLAY FISHER-PRICE™ PLAY & LEARN Your children can grow and develop different skills with early learning content such as numbers, letters, animals, and music while also developing their fine motor skills.The simple and intuitive interface makes it easy for children ages 2 to 5 to enjoy their favorite Fisher-Price™ toys and games digitally, making creative activities and educational experiences accessible anywhere. 🧩See 'n Say® Enjoy this iconic Fisher-Price™ toy that teaches animal names and sounds. 🧩Airplane: Practice counting while maneuvering the plane with your fingers, enhancing coordination skills while teaching colors, letters, and shapes. 🧩Market: Count and follow directions while at the market! Use the grocery list to fill the shopping bag with the correct number of fruits and vegetables. 🧩Memory Animals: Enhance memory skills while having fun with animals in this card matching game. 🧩Doodle Pad: Explore creativity in a fun and mess-free way as kids express themselves by drawing with their fingertips on-screen. 🧩Alphabet Fun: A great and engaging way to learn the alphabet and expand vocabulary. It's an enjoyable and interactive method that helps individuals of all ages become familiar with each letter, while also enhancing their understanding of related words and concepts. 🧩Shape Sorter: Enhance problem-solving skills while promoting shape recognition and hand-eye coordination as kids fit shapes into corresponding holes. 🧩Smartphone: Build vocabulary, early learning, and pretend play all at once! Tap the keys on this playful phone for ABCs, days of the week, shapes, and so much more. 🧩Horse Care: Taking care of animals is a way to work on children's empathy and emotional awareness. Through small tasks, they will be able to participate in the relationship of caring for horses in different ways. 🧩Xylophone: Express and explore creativity through music or follow the prompts to play a familiar tune. Play and learn with these Fisher-Price™ educational games! FISHER-PRICE™ PLAY & LEARN FEATURES 🧩Games inspired by Fisher-Price™ toys 🧩Educational activities that foster an interest in language and creativity 🧩Games for toddlers and kids ages 2 to 5 🧩Simple and intuitive interface 🧩Accessible anywhere ABOUT PLAYKIDS EDUJOY Edujoy has more than 70 games aimed at children of all ages. We love creating educational and fun games to play for you and your children. If you have any suggestions or questions, do not hesitate to send us your feedback or leave a comment.
